product_vision.name: IntelliDesign AI
product_vision.description: IntelliDesign AI is a revolutionary, AI-native design platform that empowers teams to go from idea to high-fidelity, code-ready mockups in minutes. It's a collaborative space where product managers, designers, and developers can seamlessly generate, refine, and export UI/UX designs using natural language, sketches, or existing application screenshots.
target_users: Product Managers & Entrepreneurs: To quickly visualize and iterate on product ideas without needing deep design skills.
UI/UX Designers: To accelerate their workflow, automate repetitive tasks, and focus on high-level creative problem-solving.
Frontend Developers: To receive production-ready design specifications and code components, reducing the gap between design and implementation.
product_vision.differentiation: Unlike existing tools that bolt AI on as a feature, IntelliDesign AI is built from the ground up with AI at its core. Our key differentiator is the end-to-end AI-powered workflow, from initial concept generation (text, sketch, URL) to intelligent, context-aware design refinement and direct, high-quality code generation (React, Flutter), making the design-to-development handoff virtually seamless.

core_features.ai_powered_generation: Users can generate multi-screen application mockups from simple text prompts, uploaded hand-drawn sketches, or by providing a URL or screenshot of an existing app.
core_features.intelligent_editor: A drag-and-drop canvas editor with AI-powered smart guides, automatic alignment, and component snapping. It understands design context to make editing fluid and intuitive.
core_features.component_and_template_library: A vast library of pre-built components and full-page templates. The AI suggests relevant components and templates based on the user's project context and design goals.
core_features.real_time_collaboration: Google Docs-style real-time collaboration, allowing multiple users to edit designs simultaneously. Features include live cursors, commenting, and version history.
core_features.multi_format_export: Export designs to various formats, including high-resolution images (PNG, JPG), design tool formats (Figma), and production-ready code for popular frontend frameworks (React, Flutter).
core_features.ai_design_assistant: An integrated AI assistant that provides proactive suggestions to improve color contrast for accessibility (WCAG compliance), recommends better typography pairings, and suggests layout improvements for better visual hierarchy.

technology_stack.summary: The proposed stack uses a microservices architecture to ensure scalability, maintainability, and the ability to use the best tool for each job. Python's FastAPI is chosen for AI services due to its rich ML ecosystem, while Node.js is selected for its performance in real-time I/O operations, ideal for the collaboration service.

system_architecture.description: The system is designed as a distributed, microservice-based architecture. A central API Gateway acts as the single entry point for the frontend client. It routes requests to the appropriate backend microservice, each responsible for a specific domain (collaboration, AI, exports). This separation of concerns allows for independent scaling and development of services.

text_to_wireframe.name: Text-to-Wireframe Generation
steps: 1. **Prompt Ingestion**: User enters a text description (e.g., 'A login screen with email, password fields, and a Google login button').
2. **LLM Interpretation**: The prompt is sent to an LLM (e.g., fine-tuned Llama 3 or GPT-4) with a system prompt engineered to extract UI structure.
3. **Component Extraction**: The LLM returns a structured JSON object representing the UI, e.g., `{"type": "container", "layout": "vertical", "children": [{"type": "input", "label": "Email"}, ...]}
4. **Layout Engine**: A layout engine on the backend processes this JSON, calculating positions (x, y) and dimensions (width, height) for each component.
5. **Canvas Rendering**: The final structured data is sent to the frontend, which renders the components onto the design canvas.

sketch_to_wireframe.name: Sketch-to-Wireframe Conversion
steps: 1. **Image Preprocessing**: User uploads a sketch. The image is converted to grayscale and normalized.
2. **Object Detection**: A vision model (e.g., a fine-tuned YOLOv8 or DETR) identifies bounding boxes of potential UI elements (rectangles, circles, text blocks).

3. **Component Classification**: Each detected bounding box is passed to a classifier, which maps it to a UI component (e.g., a rectangle with text inside becomes a 'button'). OCR is used to extract text.
4. **Structure Generation**: The classified components and their coordinates are assembled into the same structured JSON format used by the text-to-wireframe flow.
5. **Canvas Rendering**: The data is sent to the frontend for rendering.

ai_suggestions.name: Context-Aware Design Assistant
steps: 1. **Context Analysis**: The AI service receives the context of the user's current selection or the entire screen's design data.
2. **Heuristic Checks**: The service runs a series of checks against the data. For example, it calculates the color contrast ratio between text and its background to check against WCAG standards.
3. **Suggestion Generation**: If an issue is found, the AI generates a specific, actionable suggestion (e.g., 'Contrast is too low. Suggestion: Change text color to #FFFFFF').
4. **Display to User**: The suggestion is displayed non-intrusively in the UI, allowing the user to accept or ignore it.

phase_1_mvp.title: Phase 1: MVP - Core AI Generation & Basic Editing (1-3 Months)
phase_1_mvp.goal: Launch a functional product that validates the core value proposition of AI-powered design generation.
features: Basic drag-and-drop editor to move and resize generated elements.
Property panel to edit basic styles like color and font size.
Export project to PNG and JPG.

phase_2_collaboration.title: Phase 2: Collaboration & Intelligence (4-6 Months)
phase_2_collaboration.goal: Transform the tool into a collaborative platform and enhance its intelligence.
features: Real-time multi-user editing on the same canvas.
AI Design Assistant for accessibility and style suggestions.

phase_3_integration.title: Phase 3: Professional Tooling & Workflow Integration (7-12 Months)
phase_3_integration.goal: Position the product as an indispensable tool for professional design and development teams.
features: Advanced export options: React (Component-based) and Flutter.
Version history and branching for designs.
Workflow integrations with Jira and Trello to link designs to tasks.

security.access_control: Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with predefined roles: 'Owner', 'Editor', and 'Viewer' for each project to ensure users can only perform authorized actions.
security.data_encryption: All data will be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3. Sensitive data in the database (e.g., user info, project data) will be encrypted at rest using AWS KMS or equivalent.
security.secure_sharing: Project sharing will be handled via secure, unguessable URLs. Options will be provided to add password protection or set expiration dates for public links.
